title: Assistant Manager - E-commerce Sales
jobDescription:
About OMRON Assistant Manager
- E-commerce Sales organization committed to creating new social values. Today, In the APAC region, OMRON has a strong presence in Industrial Automation , Healthcare , and Device & Module Solutions . Let’s begin the exciting journey of Shaping Future 2030 together with us! About OMRON Healthcare Business With a vision “To advance health and empower people worldwide to live life to the fullest”, OMRON’s Healthcare Business produces internationally acclaimed and certified medical devices such as Digital Blood Pressure Monitors, Thermometers, Nebulizers, devices related to pain and weight management etc. Understand more about our Healthcare Business HERE . Short Description Job

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Weekly sellout execution, ensuring 30 Days stock to maintain with the seller to avoid any stock out issue on the platform. This needs regular follow ups with the distributor and seller. Keeping track of pos out – platform wise and sku wise weekly sales tracker to maintain. This will help in identification of gap at sales side and taking corrective actions. Execution of marketing campaigns along with marketing team. Keeping record of campaign performance and sharing inputs on business performance. Sharing input, suggestions and ideas on making creatives to agency along with marketing team. Participating in e-com. marketing review discussions with agency. Creating monthly deal working as per available coop budget. Tracking deal performance and submitting the claims to finance. Streamline business on already onboarded platforms. Snapdeal.com, Moglix.com, Seniority.com, shopclues.com, 1mg.com, pharmeasy.com, netmeds.com, Medikabazaar.com, industrybuying.com Execution of new platform onboarding. Nykaa, Blinkit, Zepto, Medi buddy, ONDC (Govt of India initiative) etc. Education & Experience:
- Minimum

title: Assistant Manager - Marketing
jobDescription:
About OMRON Assistant Manager
- Marketing organization committed to creating new social values. Today, In the APAC region, OMRON has a strong presence in Industrial Automation , Healthcare , and Device & Module Solutions . Let’s begin the exciting journey of Shaping Future 2030 together with us! About OMRON Healthcare Business With a vision “To advance health and empower people worldwide to live life to the fullest”, OMRON’s Healthcare Business produces internationally acclaimed and certified medical devices such as Digital Blood Pressure Monitors, Thermometers, Nebulizers, devices related to pain and weight management etc. Understand more about our Healthcare Business HERE . Short Description Purpose of position: As an Assistant Manager for Digital Marketing we are looking for an experienced and result-driven Digital Marketing Professional to join our awesome marketing team! As a Digital Marketing Executive at our company, the individual will be responsible for setting up, implementing, and managing the overall digital marketing strategy of the company. Digital marketing strategies are extremely important for our company's success, so the role will play a crucial role in achieving our business goals and objectives. We are expecting the candidate to have a hand on experience in digital marketing tools across platforms along with strategy development & Execution of digital marketing strategies with a passion to explore new digital marketing tools and channels.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Develop digital marketing calendar followed by implementation & overall management of digital marketing strategy & activities for the organization. Design, Implement & Manage digital marketing activities across a broad range of digital marketing channels (Social Media, SEO, SEM, Social Media, GA, Email, Mobile, Display, Search, programmatic). Manage and maintain the company’s owned/paid media including websites, mobile apps, email/CRM software, Ad campaigns and validate impact with online customer research. Prepare and manage the digital marketing A&P with focus on managing ROI and KPIs across the channels incl. Impressions, Engagement & Sales numbers. Manage and develop online content incl. Social SEO, SEM , Search & Display Ad campaigns. Managing External partners/Agencies for content creation & channel management. Conduct research on market trends, brand’s audiences and competitors, and end-to-end consumer journey to drive engagements and conversions. Operating Network: Internal: Marketing team, Customer Service team, Sales team External: External Digital Partners i.e. E com Portals like Amazon, Digital Agencies, Market Research companies. Measurement of criteria:
- Technical
- Content Copywriting/Editing /Creative Writing
- Competitive Analysis
- Video/ Visual Content Strategy Management Inc. Curation/ Conceptualization / implementation.
- Digital paid media advertising incl. GA/OTT/Pragrammatic/PPC
- Digital Marketing Analytics/Strategy
- Email Marketing Strategy.
- Social Management incl. page management/ advertisement & analytics for Facebook/Instagram, Linked In, Youtube etc.
- Google Ads/Analytics
- SEO management incl. Keyword Research
- Marketing Budget/ Campaign Management
- Performance Measurement
- DTC/Website Management with hands on experience in GA / Word Press etc. Education & Experience:
- Minimum

EDUCATION:
Higher vocational / professional education (Bachelor Degree)
- Preferred

- Preferred experience: 4 – 7 yrs Location: Gurgaon Why Join us OMRON’s mission is to improve lives and contribute to a better society. title: [OCB-IN] Senior Executive, Accounting & Finance Executive
jobDescription: Short Description Role and Responsibility Handle a full set of accounts (including General Ledger, Accounts Receivables, Accounts Payables & Fixed Assets) Maintaining the General Ledger and executing day-to-day entries for all transactions Processing vendor invoices, employee expense claims Tracking customer outstanding balances and following up on collections Keep the fixed assets record up to date Reconciliation (i.e. bank, intercompany account, vendors, inventory etc) Perform month-end & year-end closing independently Daily updates of the cashbook & monitor the cash book fund requirement Maintain the monthly exchange rate in the system Check to ensure master (Customer, vendors, employees) in system are correctly created by the counterparty (Shared service centre) Tax Compliance Liaise with tax consultant on the company yearly income tax (CIT) Liaise with outsourced accounting firm on the Indian local tax filing (i.e. TDS, GST, etc) Liaise with both internal and external auditors, handle audit queries and liaise with auditors Liaise with the counterparty (Shared service Centre – Payment factory) for the monthly payment for vendor, employee claim, tax-related payment etc Liaise with banks Ensure compliance with all financial reporting, statutory requirements and internal controls and company rules & regulation Financial reporting to both Japan and Asia Pacific Headquarter Support ad hoc matters requested by the business operations Contribute for process improvements Other ad-hoc duties as assigned Requirements & Qualifications
